title: KeywordHunter

panels.title: Audit chain
panels.description: 1 = the latest hash chain verification found it intact; 0 = broken or the verification failed with an error (see keywordhunter_audit_chain_verify_error). Absent until the first verification after start-up.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Status of the latest scheduled backup (absent when BACKUP_DIR is not set or no run yet).

panels.title: Backup age
panels.description: Seconds since the latest successful scheduled backup.

panels.title: Engines up
panels.description: Enabled engines whose latest health check succeeded.

panels.description: Latency of each engine's latest successful health check. Down engines have no value (the time a failed check took is not a response time).
